# BgRemove

> Free AI background remover that runs 100% in the browser. Exports transparent 4K PNGs. No signup, no uploads, no watermark.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://bgremove.idcardtools.com): Upload an image, remove its background, download a transparent 4K PNG. Processing is entirely client-side (WebAssembly).
- [Blog](https://bgremove.idcardtools.com/blog): Guides, comparisons, and tutorials on background removal.
- [About](https://bgremove.idcardtools.com/about): How BgRemove works, who it's for.
- [Privacy](https://bgremove.idcardtools.com/privacy): Images are never uploaded to a server.
- [Terms](https://bgremove.idcardtools.com/terms): Terms of use.

## Key facts

- Price: Free
- Signup: Not required
- Watermark: None
- Processing: 100% client-side (WebAssembly)
- Output: Transparent PNG, 4K (3840×2160)
- Supported input: PNG, JPG, WEBP
- Works on: Desktop, tablet, mobile browsers
- Domains: bgremove.idcardtools.com

## FAQ

### Is BgRemove free?
Yes. Free with no signup, no watermark, and no hidden limits.

### Are images uploaded?
No. All processing happens locally in the browser. Images never leave your device.

### What output do I get?
Transparent PNG at 4K (3840×2160), preserving aspect ratio.

### Does it work on mobile?
Yes. Works in any modern mobile browser without an app install.

### Which image formats are supported?
PNG, JPG, and WEBP input. Output is always transparent PNG.
